title: Role of Serum Total Antioxidant Level in Preterm Labor
brief_summary: The aim of this study is to detect the association between maternal serum antioxidant level and preterm labor.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Preterm labor(pregnant between 28th and 37th week).
* Singleton pregnancy.
* Amnion membranes were intact

Exclusion Criteria:

* Past history of preterm labor or premature delivery.
* Urinary tract infections and any other infections.
* Poly- or oligohydramnios.
* Fetal distress, fetal or uterine anomaly.
* Membranes rupture and placenta pathology.
* Preeclampsia or intrauterine growth retardation
study_population: pregnant women attending the outpatient obstetric clinic and inpatient of Obstetrics and Gynecology department or when they will be admitted to the delivary room of Ain Shams university hospital.
